name: pr-pulse
description: Browser extension that turns GitHub pull requests into one configurable dashboard, reducing repo-hopping and keeping data on your device.

scripts.test: bun extension/lib/providers/github-provider.test.ts && bun extension/lib/pr-view.test.ts && bun extension/lib/pr-notify.test.ts && bun extension/lib/popup-session.test.ts && bun extension/lib/storage.test.ts && bun extension/lib/jira.test.ts
scripts.manifest: bun run manifest:chrome && bun run manifest:firefox
scripts.build:chrome: vite build --mode chrome --outDir dist/chrome && bun run manifest:chrome
scripts.build:firefox: vite build --mode firefox --outDir dist/firefox && bun run manifest:firefox
scripts.build: bun run build:chrome && bun run build:firefox
scripts.zip: bun run zip:chrome && bun run zip:firefox
scripts.generate:chrome: bun run clean && bun run lint && bun run build:chrome && bun run zip:chrome
scripts.generate:firefox: bun run clean && bun run lint && bun run build:firefox && bun run zip:firefox
scripts.generate: bun run clean && bun run lint && bun run build && bun run zip

author: Utkarsh Chourasia <utkarshchourasia.in>
